title: Phantoms on the long haul
summary: Ride far enough and the night sky turns hostile. Phantoms start hunting riders under open skies whether or not they have slept, and they keep coming more often the further the train goes.
highlights: Deep into a run, phantoms find you even if you sleep
They come more often the further you travel, and some brave the daylight
Go far enough and they arrive with buffs, like other monsters
